# issuance-client-properties

<!-- Generated by tools/config-reference.py from servlets/attestation-issuer/src/main/resources/META-INF/oidf-settings/issuance-client-properties.json. Do not edit: change the catalogue, then run python3 tools/config-reference.py. -->

The settings of the `issuance-client-properties` component of `servlets/attestation-issuer`, read by package `com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.servlet.attestation`: generated from its catalogue, [issuance-client-properties.json](../../servlets/attestation-issuer/src/main/resources/META-INF/oidf-settings/issuance-client-properties.json), by `tools/config-reference.py`, and checked in CI. [How to read a row](README.md#reading-a-row).

Under the production profile a violation by one of these settings refuses `ATTESTATION_ISSUER` ([components](../development/settings-catalogue.md#components)).

| Setting | Default | What it does | When it's wrong | Profile | Security |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `attestation_issuer` (extended property) | Unset | The iss of the attestations minted for this client; a client without it is not an attestation client | **Per request**: Missing: the client is unknown to the attester. PingFederate drops an extended property it has not been told about (F-0041), so each is declared server-side | Any | Yes |
| `attestation_issued_ttl` (extended property) | `300`; seconds, 1 to 64800 | How long a minted attestation lives, in seconds, and never past the evidence; at most OIDF_ATTESTER_MAX_ISSUED_TTL, and never above 64800 (the AI Agent Profile's 18-hour ceiling) | **Per request**: Not a whole number of seconds from 1 to 64800, or above OIDF_ATTESTER_MAX_ISSUED_TTL in production: the client's configuration is refused (invalid_client, naming the property, never its value) and the attester skips the client with a warning. Above the cap in development: clamped to the cap with a warning | Any | Yes |
| `attestation_spiffe_bundle` (extended property) | Unset; a JSON object | The trust bundle, an inline JWK Set, that verifies this client's evidence; this or attestation_bundle_url is required for every evidence type but a wallet instance attestation | **Per request**: Not a JSON object, not a JWK Set, or one with no keys: the client's configuration is refused (invalid_client, naming the property) and the attester skips the client with a warning | Any | Yes |
| `attestation_bundle_url` (extended property) | Unset; an http or https URL | Where the trust bundle is fetched from (and cached) at issuance, in place of attestation_spiffe_bundle; the fetch is held to the outbound fetch rules, with no operator exemption | **Per request**: Not an http or https URL: the client's configuration is refused (invalid_client, naming the property) and the attester skips the client with a warning - from 0.6.0; before, it failed at the fetch. Unreachable with nothing cached: that client's issuance fails | Any | Yes |
| `attestation_entitlement` (extended property) | Unset | The client's RFC 9396 authorization_details ceiling, a JSON array held to the RAR models when the configuration is parsed; an instance's own ceiling must sit within it | **Per request**: Not a JSON array, or one the models refuse: the client's configuration is refused (invalid_client) and the attester skips the client with a warning | Any | Yes |
| `attestation_signing_key_ref` (extended property) | Unset | The OpenBao transit key this client's attestations are signed with; exactly one of this and attestation_signing_jwk | **Per request**: Both or neither set: invalid_client at issuance. Set with no OpenBao configured: server_error | Any | Yes |
| `attestation_signing_jwk` (extended property) | Unset; a secret, never shown | The private key this client's attestations are signed with, as an inline JWK; exactly one of this and attestation_signing_key_ref | **Per request**: Not a JSON object: the client's configuration is refused (invalid_client) and the attester skips the client with a warning. Not a usable key: invalid_client at issuance | Any | Yes |
| `attestation_instances` (extended property) | Unset | The client's instance bindings, a JSON array of objects: each a subject (spiffe_id, or a wallet instance's id), an optional entitlement ceiling within the client's, and metadata | **Per request**: Not a JSON array of objects, or a ceiling the models refuse: the client's configuration is refused (invalid_client) and the attester skips the client with a warning | Any | Yes |
| `attestation_trust_domain` (extended property) | Unset | The trust domain the client's evidence must belong to: pinned for SPIFFE and wallet evidence when set, and required for the cloud evidence types, whose SPIFFE path it anchors | **Per request**: Missing for a cloud evidence type: the client's configuration is refused (invalid_client) and the attester skips the client with a warning | Any | Yes |
| `attestation_evidence` (extended property) | `spiffe-jwt`; one of `spiffe-jwt`, `gke-sa-token`, `gcp-id-token`, `eks-sa-token`, `aws-sts-web-identity`, `aks-sa-token`, `azure-mi-token`, `wallet-instance-attestation` | The evidence type the client's instances present | **Per request**: Not one of the types, in any case (before 0.6.0 only the lower-case spelling was taken): the client's configuration is refused (invalid_client) and the attester skips the client with a warning | Any | Yes |
| `attestation_evidence_issuer` (extended property) | Unset | The iss the client's cloud evidence must carry (a cluster's or an account's issuer); unset, any issuer the trust bundle verifies | **Not checked**: Read as given; evidence from another issuer is refused at issuance | Any | Yes |
| `attestation_asserted_context_resolver` (extended property) | Unset | The asserted-context resolver (entra-directory) whose ceiling narrows this client's evidenced one when a request carries asserted_context - but the attester's PingFederate client store reads only the other eleven names, so on a PingFederate client it has no effect (F-0230) | **Not checked**: Ignored on a PingFederate client (F-0230): the request's asserted_context is ignored and the evidenced ceiling applies unnarrowed | Any | Yes |
